# Glyphin

> Glyphin teaches you to read Thai script through real, high-frequency words —
> with guided letter lessons, progressive decoding, and retrieval practice.

Most apps drop you in front of an alphabet chart and ask you to memorize it.
Glyphin instead teaches the highest-frequency letter and word combinations
first, so learners start reading real Thai words from day one. Lessons introduce
useful words, letters, and reading rules in a progressive path, then have you
practice them in new contexts before revealing answers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://glyphin.app/): What Glyphin is and how to start the first lesson.
- [How Glyphin teaches Thai reading](https://glyphin.app/about): The method — real words, progressive decoding, retrieval practice, and evidence-informed lesson design.
- [Thai reading lessons](https://glyphin.app/learn): The lesson index. Browse the step-by-step reading path that introduces words, letters, and rules.

## Lessons

Individual lessons live at `https://glyphin.app/learn/{id}`. The complete,
canonical list of lesson URLs comes from the active published curriculum:

- [Sitemap](https://glyphin.app/sitemap.xml): Every indexable page, including all published lesson URLs.

## Notes

- Interactive learner tools (`/alphabet`, `/practice`, `/words`) and account pages (`/auth`) are app surfaces intended for use inside the product and are not part of the public, indexable content set.
- The canonical origin is `https://glyphin.app`. Non-canonical hosts (preview deployments) are not indexable.
